## Verification

- [ ] Existing deployed behavior is preserved or differences are documented.
- [ ] Module builds against the target AzerothCore revision, or build blocker is explained.
- [ ] Relevant in-game tests completed; record commands, characters, and results below.
- [ ] Playerbot versus real-player behavior considered where applicable.
- [ ] One-time grants, persistence, configuration, and reload cases tested where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, server credentials, webhook tokens, or personal data included.
- [ ] No unapproved production deployment or restart.
